profile.name: Sushant Kumar Roushan
profile.headline: Understanding policy. Improving practice.
profile.intro: Development Studies postgraduate student and development practitioner interested in how institutions, political incentives and public systems shape people’s access to welfare.
profile.degree: Master’s in Development Studies · Azim Premji University (in progress)
profile.about: My work and studies sit at the intersection of public institutions, frontline implementation and social outcomes. I bring an academic foundation in Economics, postgraduate study in Development Studies, and experience connected to district-level development priorities.
profile.interests: Welfare implementation and state capacity; bureaucratic autonomy and political control; political incentives and welfare policy design; gender, autonomy and social norms.
